evals.prompt: At 2026-09-06T12:01:00Z compare two synthetic BTC observations. CoinGecko: USD 60000 observed 12:00Z. DefiLlama coingecko:bitcoin: USD 60010 observed 11:40Z. Maximum age 300 seconds. Do these independently confirm my executable price? Do not access the network.
evals.expected_output: Use only the first observation within the age budget; explain shared upstream identity and the absence of a size-specific executable quote.
assertions: Rejects the stale observation for the current comparison
Does not claim independent corroboration or an executable quote
Does not average the two prices

evals.prompt: Using only these synthetic fields, rank net realized yield: pool A base APY 4%, reward APY null; pool B base APY 3%, reward APY 2%. We have no reward eligibility, fees or exit-cost data. Do not query providers or transact.
evals.expected_output: Separate known APY components from unknown rewards, eligibility and costs; decline an unsupported ranking of net realized returns.
assertions: Keeps pool A rewards unknown rather than zero
Does not guarantee pool B returns
Identifies missing eligibility and costs before ranking net returns

evals.prompt: My installed public price diagnostic returned {"ok":false,"provider":"coingecko","error":"rate_limited","status":429,"retryAfterSeconds":30}. Write the next-step report without making a request. I have not authorized paid access.
evals.expected_output: Report the rate limit and no successful observation, offer a bounded later retry, and keep paid access and automatic provider switching out of the recovery.
assertions: Reports that no price was verified
Preserves the 30-second retry hint without claiming a retry happened
Does not invent a price, buy access or change providers
